where teacher_id = #{teacherId} and del_flag = 0 limit #{currentPage}, #{pageSize}

select distinct su.user_id as user_id, user_name, email, nike_name, su.status as status, su.create_time as create_time, remark from sys_user su right join sys_user_role sur on sur.user_id = su.user_id
where del_flag = 0 and role_id = #{userQuery.roleId}
and user_name like concat(#{userQuery.username}, '%')
and email like concat(#{userQuery.email}, '%')
and nike_name like concat(#{userQuery.nikeName}, '%')

select count(*) from sys_user where user_id = #{userId} and del_flag = 0 and status = 0
